description: Department of Local Government - Meeting of the Karainagar P/S for Appoint Vice Chairman
categorisation: This gazette notice announces a meeting for the election to fill the vacancy of Vice Chairman of a local authority (Karainagar Pradeshiya Sabha). It is issued under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and specifically references the Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act. The content pertains directly to electoral processes at the local government level, fitting the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) for matters concerning electoral processes, candidate nominations, and filling vacancies.
